mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.deptno, d.dname as dept_name, u.enabled, u.regdate, r.role_id, r.role_name as auth from kosauser u left join dept d on u.deptno = d.deptno left join user_roles ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join roles r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where u.username = #{username}

select u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.deptno, d.dname as dept_name, u.enabled, u.regdate, r.role_id, r.role_name as auth from kosauser u left join dept d on u.deptno = d.deptno left join user_roles ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join roles r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where not exists ( select 1 from user_roles admin_ur join roles admin_r on admin_ur.role_id = admin_r.role_id where admin_ur.user_id = u.user_id and admin_r.role_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN' ) order by u.user_id, r.role_id
